statements.status_notes: Uptime Kuma 2.x records postcss-selector-parser 6.1.4 only in the supplementary frontend build SBOM (stylelint and eslint-plugin-vue devDependencies). The runtime image runs npm prune --omit=dev and does not install those packages under /app/node_modules, so the ReDoS-prone selector parsing path is not present in the production container filesystem.
